tools.name: csv_profile
tools.description: Return a deterministic profile of CSV text: row count, column count, each column's name, whether it looks numeric or text, and how many blanks it has. Runs locally without an AI model, so it is fast and always available.

tools.name: analyze_csv
tools.description: Ask a question about CSV data in plain English and get a written answer back (totals, trends, outliers, comparisons, a recommended chart). The CSV text is analysed and discarded; nothing is stored.
